description: List stored transactions in a date range, optionally for one account or category, or only the ones no rule has categorised yet. Totals are reported per currency and never added across currencies.

account.description: Limit to one account, as named at import

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: the start of the current month

limit.description: Rows returned, default 200. Totals always cover the whole range

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today

uncategorized.description: Only transactions with no category yet

name: transactions_list
title: List transactions
